model.name: R19.88: Every rb-object-item must initialize all interactivity — no partial-init items.
model.description: BUG: some rb-object-item instances fail ALL interactivity together: no pointer/hand cursor on hover, no collapse-to-icon on click, no drawer-open. Other items of the same type work. This is a per-item INITIALIZATION inconsistency — some items miss the event listener attachment / CSS class / interactive setup entirely. Timing-sensitive: slightly differs between Mac browser and iOS. FIX: rb-object-item initialization must be deterministic and complete for EVERY instance — cursor, click handler (collapse + drawer), drag. No item may be left in a partially-initialized state regardless of render timing or platform.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "on desktop hover shows hand/finger cursor on working files; some items with no visible reason do NOT — and those also do not compact to icon or open the drawer. some kind of initialisation issue on the item. slightly differs mac browser vs ios."
model.crossRefNote: R19.87 (iOS drawer broken) and R19.83 (file items re-render lifecycle) are likely symptoms of the same root: partial initialization. R19.88 captures the root cause — deterministic complete init for every item instance.
model.refinedByNote: Refined by R19.88.A: whenDefined gate fixed first render but innerHTML churn on re-render re-introduces the race. R19.88.A = stop destroy+recreate, diff/update in place.
